# Kiki Warrior

> Kiki Warrior is a free online safety course for children aged 6 to 13. Kids learn how to stay safe online through short animated video lessons presented by Kiki, a young warrior character, followed by quizzes. They earn pieces of the Armour of God as rewards, and parents follow their progress on a parent dashboard.

## Key facts
- Website: https://kikiwarrior.com
- Price: the online safety course is free
- Ages: two streams, ages 6-9 and ages 10-13
- Format: 40 short video lessons with narration, quizzes (70% pass mark), rewards and a completion certificate
- For parents: parent dashboard to track each child's progress, multiple children per family account
- Values: faith-based, encouraging kindness, courage and wise choices online
- Contact: privacy@kikiwarrior.com

## Course: Internet Safety for Kids
https://kikiwarrior.com/courses/internet-safety

Ages 6-9 modules:
- What is the Internet?
- SMART Rules for staying safe online
- Be Kind Online

Ages 10-13 modules:
- Internet Safety 101
- Privacy and Passwords
- Protect Your Profile
- Cyberbullying and Respect
- Scams and Phishing

## Book: Kiki's Armour of God
https://kikiwarrior.com/books/armour-of-god

A Christian workbook for children aged 4-12 by Nonala Tose Dagada. It teaches the Armour of God from Ephesians 6 (Belt of Truth, Breastplate of Righteousness, Shoes of Peace, Shield of Faith, Helmet of Salvation, Sword of the Spirit) through activities, prayers and Bible verses. Available as an ebook from major online stores.
